name: Fujisaki Shizuka
source:
A very kind and authoritative girl, she is [spoiler]the student council president and [/spoiler]the hostess of the dormitory.

Very talented in domestic chores and very feminine, she plays a little role of the moth... big sister of the residents. From time to time, she gives off an aura that is quite scary and forces to submission ...

[spoiler]She's very strict with the members of the student council and is described by [url=https://vndb.org/c69159]Haruya[/url] as a man with a girl appearance.[/spoiler]
